takeaways.text: **Table rows stay on one line on a phone**: On a phone, rows on the Resources page, group and Total rows on the Limits page, Settings ▸ Meter icons and the resource drawer tables now show the name with one value on the right instead of wrapping.
**Meter icons scrolls again**: In Settings ▸ Meter icons, the list is no longer cut off at one screen, so you can scroll to the end.

**Top resources fits at desktop width**: On the Overview and account pages, the Top resources card no longer needs a sideways scroll, and the 7-day change now appears in the hover card that opens from the Usage and Watch for cells.

**Of limit is visible in the resource drawer**: On the Resources page, opening a resource shows the metrics table with its Of limit column on screen at desktop width, with the 30-day chart still below the table.

**Every change is now checked for UI glitches and slow returning visits**: This affects how the app is tested before release, so layout, contrast, interaction and slow-load problems get caught before they reach you.

**Newer Cloudflare meters show up again**: On the Limits page, meters such as Browser Run now appear, because the usage query no longer fails as a whole when a newer meter allows a shorter date range.
**Shares past 10× read correctly in Forecast**: In the Forecast column on the Limits page and in the share cells on the Resources page, a value like 39× no longer shows as "39 %".
**Limits opens folded, and Meter icons is a one-line table**: On the Limits page, meters start folded, and in Settings ▸ Meter icons you can filter meters and pick each icon in place.

**Phone and loading polish**: On phones, the Settings account list, bulk selection bar, status bar and landing table now fit the screen, and every page shows skeleton placeholders while loading and a Try again button on errors.
**Faster loads**: On every page, repeat visits reuse downloaded files and the app downloads about 28% less JavaScript up front (423 → 310 KB gzipped).

**Seven more Cloudflare products are metered**: On the Limits and Resources pages, you can now track Browser Run, Images, Stream, Realtime, Email Sending, Logpush and Zero Trust seats against their allowances.
**Tag rows show their share, not a made-up quota**: On the Limits page, each tag row now shows its percentage of the account's meter in a new "Share" column instead of a quota of its own.
**Choose your own meter icons**: In Settings ▸ Meter icons, you can change the icon shown for each meter on the Limits page, which now starts with a default icon for each kind of meter.

**Pages load with far less JavaScript**: Every page in the app now loads about 45% less compressed JavaScript (765 KB down to 421 KB), because heavy parts such as charts and dialogs load only when needed.
**Phone popups can always be closed**: On a phone, every sheet, drawer, picker and dialog now has a close ×, and also closes when you tap outside, swipe down on the handle, or press Esc or back.

**Tags are now saved in Cloudflare**: On the Resources page and the Tags page, use Move to Cloudflare to store your tags on the resources themselves (as `project.<name>`), so they also show up in the Cloudflare dashboard.

**Limits for each account, by product or by tag**: Under each account in the sidebar, open Limits to see pooled quotas by product or by tag, and click a tag row to open a drawer with its resources, shared quota and pace.
**One token per account**: In Settings ▸ Cloudflare API tokens, a single token now reads usage and, if it has Account › Tag › Edit, writes tags, and the token list fits on one line per token.
**Tags belong to an account**: In the sidebar, Account ▸ Tags now opens that account's own tag manager, and the global Tags page lists every account's tags grouped by account.

**Ticking rows no longer jumps pages**: On the Resources page, ticking a row on page 2 or later keeps you on that page, and the tag picker near the bottom of the screen opens upward with Done always in view.

**Pace: time to each cap**: On the Overview, Limits, Resources and Account pages, choose a Pace window (6h, 12h, 24h or 7d) in the header to see how soon each meter will hit its cap at the current rate.
**Billed column**: In the Accounts card on the Overview page, you can now compare what Cloudflare actually billed with the dashboard's estimate for each account and product.

**Deleted and unbound resources**: On the Resources page, resources that no longer exist in Cloudflare are marked Deleted, and listed resources that no Worker uses are marked Unbound, so you can filter them with the new Status field.

**No more false "At cap" or huge trend numbers**: On the Resources page, a resource only shows its account's time to the cap when it actually drives that usage, and Trend 7d no longer shows figures like 18688% when last week was nearly empty.

**Editable Overview numbers**: On the Overview and each account's Overview, the top row of numbers (Bill so far, Forecast, Watch for and so on) is now a card you can edit, move or remove like any other.

**Usage and Watch for on both Overview pages**: On the Overview page and each account's Overview, you can now see how much of your allotment you've used and which meter is closest to its cap, with the Accounts card showing both for every account side by side.
**Usage and Watch for on Resources**: On the Resources page's All tab, every resource now has Usage, Watch for and Trend 7d columns, so you can compare resources and spot the one nearest a limit.

**Opens instantly from cache**: When you reopen usageflare, the dashboard now draws right away from your last visit and quietly refreshes in the background, and the status bar shows "Synced just now" once the numbers update.
**Public landing page, dashboard at /app**: Visiting the site root now shows a landing page, the dashboard lives under /app, and old links like /limits and /resources redirect there.
**Bulk labels**: On the Resources page, select rows, groups or every row and use the floating bar's **Labels…** button to add or remove labels on many resources at once, with Undo.

**Usage dashboard on real Cloudflare data**: On the Overview page and under each account in the sidebar, you can now see bill so far, forecast, limits at risk and a resource breakdown for every account your tokens reach.
**Bulk labels**: On any Resources page, select rows, groups or everything, then use **Labels…** in the floating bar to stage label changes, apply them in one go and undo from the toast.

**Storage forecast in GB-months**: In the Forecast cost column on the Resources and Limits pages, storage is now billed on the month's average size, with the free allowance applied once per account, instead of an inflated month-end projection.

**Saving a token works again**: In Settings ▸ Cloudflare API tokens, Save now stores the token, it appears in the list immediately, and any refusal shows a readable message instead of "[object Object]".
**Encrypted tokens behind Access**: In Settings ▸ Cloudflare API tokens, you can add, replace, test and delete tokens that are stored encrypted and only ever shown as their last four characters.
